notes: Skill was followable overall. Points of friction: (1) the paper is meant to be read in full yet Phase 1.5 literature check must come after the reports are drafted, which conflicts with writing one report file; I ran searches after forming all five analyses and before writing the file. (2) The reviewer copy from integrity_scan.py was unchanged when no injection exists, so reviewers read the original; the skill does not say whether to read the redacted file or the original in that case. (3) Phase 1.5 asks for scout/coverage/novelty scripts but a 12-query budget and no clear rule for when to stop; I ran fingerprint, 5 searches, 4 verifies, 1 scout, similarity and wrote the novelty table by hand without the novelty script. (4) quality_rubrics says an Overall 4 needs pool position >= 65 and dimension scores mostly >= 60, which pushes a mixed paper to either 3 or 4 and makes the borderline call feel forced; the EIC weighting uses confidence x weight so low-confidence accept-leaning reviewers had little pull. (5) the paper-type 'empirical' vs 'analysis' choice changes composite weights materially and the field analyst guidance gives no tie-break for method papers with an interpretability component. (6) Figures were unavailable, so interpretability claims (Figs. 3, 4, 21-28) could not be verified.
